follow_ups.title: GetItemById and UpdateItemV1 return application/json for 400s documented as application/problem+json
follow_ups.reason: BadRequest<ProblemDetails> is sent as application/json while their ProducesResponseType annotations declare application/problem+json, so clients and the OpenAPI document disagree.

follow_ups.title: Fix existing dotnet format whitespace/import-order problems in OrdersApi.cs, Order.cs and BasketState.cs
follow_ups.reason: dotnet format --verify-no-changes fails on lines this story did not change; fixing them separately keeps feature diffs small.

follow_ups.title: Architecture review labels added files as modified ('M'), so VAL-MIGRATION-IMMUTABLE flags brand-new migrations
follow_ups.reason: Any story that adds an EF Core migration gets blocked by DATA-001; the validator should use git's name-status (A vs M) against the base before calling a migration applied.

follow_ups.title: Make DATA-001 compare migrations against origin/main
follow_ups.reason: The check treats a migration that was added and never applied on the feature branch as an applied migration that was modified, which blocks every story that adds a schema change.

follow_ups.title: Get human sign-off for ARCH-005 and SEC-005 on CHK-1
follow_ups.reason: These rules require an architect's and a security reviewer's approval, which an agent cannot give.
